summary: At step 9 the Ranger has just readied her alternate +1 bow in the quiver, then selects the d arrow from the ordinary throw prompt and aims east. C dothrow.c throwit() permits ammunition without a matching launcher: it halves the computed range, prints the hand-throw message, and continues through zap.c bhit() to land the arrow. JS stops at js/dothrow.js:1372-1375 before that adjustment and flight. The actionable owner is dothrow.c throwit(), with the ordinary no-launcher branch and its existing bhit/landing tail in scope; later travel, inventory, spell, discovery, attribute, search, and look inputs are downstream of this stop.

source.branch: dothrow.c:1612-1648 runs for a non-swallowed, non-vertical, non-boomerang object with a horizontal direction. When the selected object is ammo, ammo_and_launcher(obj, uwep) is false, and obj is not a gem, C halves the positive range and prints `You aren't wielding %s, so you throw your %s by %s.` before calling bhit(). In the witness, Q moved the bow from uswapwep to uquiver; t then selected the separate arrow stack while uwep remained the primary weapon, so the no-launcher preconditions hold. The eastward first ray cell is a blocking room boundary, so bhit() leaves bhitpos at the hero square and throwit() proceeds through breaktest(), flooreffects(), placement, stacking, and throwit_return().
